column1: # D1 measurement a, Unity HISTORICAL round trips, derived from landed evidence.
# source commit -> the CI commit that published its verdict.
# A LOWER BOUND on a felt cycle: authoring time before the commit is
# not in it. It DOES include runner queue wait, deliberately, because
# waiting behind a queue is time the edit costs.
# answered=no means the round trip was spent and returned nothing
# (NO PLAYER LOG). Those rows stay in the elapsed series; they are
# reported separately as a rate, never quietly dropped.
